content.text:
I added the import libraries for the 32-bit Windows GNU target to `Cargo.toml`, scoped so they only apply when building for that target:

```toml
[target.i686-pc-windows-gnu.dependencies]
winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu = "0.4.0"
```

`winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu` is the crate that provides the Windows import libraries the `winapi` bindings link against on `i686-pc-windows-gnu`. Because of the target scope, it isn't pulled in for other platforms. I checked that the dependencies resolve (it locks to `winapi-i686-pc-windows-gnu v0.4.0`), but I haven't built for Windows: the project has no source files yet.

One assumption to check: this is the right crate if you'll use `winapi`. If you'll use the newer `windows` or `windows-sys` crates instead, the matching import-library crate is `windows_i686_gnu`, and it's normally pulled in automatically through `windows-targets`. Tell me if that's the case and I'll switch it.
